formula.overall: OVR = min(maxRating, round( sum(norm(r) * weight_r) / sum(weight_r) ))   [round = floor(x+0.5)]
formula.archetypeChoice: The game computes this OVR under every archetype valid for the player's position and assigns the archetype with the highest OVR (ties broken by EA's internal order).
formula.notes: Weights are integers; only their RELATIVE proportions matter (formula divides by the weight sum). desiredLow/High/maxRating come from the archetype's PlayerIntangibleGradePhilosophy record.

_meta.validation: Reproduces actual OverallRating for 99.9% of 16,143 players (samples/DYNASTY-REAL), mean error -0.01. See tools/validate_archetype_ovr.js.
